_comment: Runtime diagnosis result handoff for Codex follow-up discussion.

task.title: Classify SIT runtime mismatch with evidence

observed_symptom: Manual browser checks showed broken-looking index surface with mojibake-like text.
Deploy workflow was green but user-visible behavior appeared inconsistent across routes.
workflow_proof_vs_runtime_proof_gap: Existing PASS evidence leaned on source-file markers and reachability checks.
Runtime-level body integrity and route-specific rendering quality were not mandatory pass gates.
This created a false-positive risk: deploy success without proving user-visible correctness.

evidence: docker compose ps showed all SIT services up.
backend and nginx logs showed repeated 200 for /phase2/prototype, /api/v1/auth/me, /api/v1/templates.

body_integrity./phase2/prototype: readable content; Thai text appears correct
body_integrity./index.html: mojibake-like corrupted text appears in title/comments/labels

hash_check.conclusion: runtime serves current artifacts; issue is in artifact content for index route, not stale cache

header_check.interpretation: primary issue is content corruption, not service outage

rejected_buckets: stale artifact or wrong file serving

exact_next_approved_action: Apply Git fix to repair corrupted content in src/frontend/index.html (and any generator/source feeding it) using clean UTF-8 bytes.
Add CI guard for mojibake token detection on shipped HTML routes.
Redeploy SIT via Openclaw control-plane workflow only.
Update deploy acceptance checks to require runtime body integrity checks on both /index.html and /phase2/prototype, not source markers only.

prompt_for_codex_next_discussion.goal: Design and implement the minimal safe fix for index route content corruption, then strengthen SIT verification gates.
constraints: Git changes plus workflow deploy only
ask: Identify exact source of corrupted bytes entering src/frontend/index.html.
Provide minimal patch and focused tests/checks.
Propose acceptance checklist updates that block false-positive deploy PASS.
